Faithful connections, separate strokes and counters. Center glyph within central 70% square canvas. Pure BLACK on fully TRANSPARENT background. No labels, grids, text or multiple glyphs. Only THX and CCZ available. THX whole form: left 王 three rails. Right TWO vertically stacked identical crossed fork motifs. Each has long horizontal crossbar, central curved descending staff crossing it then curving down-right into long tail; near staff top a short right branch curls upward; lower separate diagonal rising from bottom-left crosses staff and terminates right just below crossbar. Preserve both upper and lower branching motifs and their free tips. No enclosing box or counters.
